execution.prompt: Design only; do not edit files. Our approved requirement is to send a receipt after a completed purchase through our sole email provider. The existing purchase flow publishes PurchaseCompleted with a purchase ID; the receipt worker can read an immutable receipt record. The provider exposes send(message, idempotencyKey), returns a message ID on acceptance, and may time out after accepting a request. It guarantees that retries using the same key do not send another message. We must retry transient failures, prevent duplicates, and expose permanent failures to operations. Tests need deterministic failure simulation. Propose the smallest technical design and verification plan, with no speculative provider switching.
checks: Designs directly from the goal without running an open-ended module diagnosis.
Allows a seam for deterministic failure control and contract isolation despite having only one provider.
Defines effect ownership, retry identity, transient/permanent failure handling, and operational visibility.
Distinguishes test-double evidence from provider contract verification.
Does not add hypothetical provider-switching infrastructure or edit files.
